projection.method: All @method registrations and statically/derivably named gateway events are inventoried. Parameter access, literal success-result keys, and literal event-payload keys are conservative source projections.
limitations: Python is dynamic: helper-produced, conditionally assembled, and forwarded payload/result fields remain unconstrained unless directly recoverable.
Direct params indexing proves required access; params.get access proves a known field but not optionality.
Source declarations establish legal/native shape and existence, not runtime reachability.
